contact.basis: Actual native dry footway vertex6.955m southwest of tower centroid, outside every extracted building footprint. Independent original USGS raster is resampled in this tower frame before geometry, without fitting or flattening.

verticalDatum: Source-specific USGS CA_SanFrancisco_B23 one-metre DEM; provider catalog NAVD88. No local survey-datum transformation; model uses provider-relative dry footway datum.
attribution: USGS National Map3DEP, CA_SanFrancisco_B23 source-specific elevation export
method: Original uncompressed F32 GeoTIFF preserved before model geometry; explicit locked dataset71693 with no visualization function. Pillow pixel reader used for build; independent stdlib TIFF decoder compares every original pixel and reproduces all derived sample values. Pixel-centre bilinear sampling in native geographic frame; no flattening or fitting.
limitations: One-metre source/export and one-metre review sampling do not establish surveyed foundation contact. Hidden foundations, paving interpolation and later site changes remain uncertain.
Provider catalog acquisition2023-04-20 is source metadata, not an independent local field survey.
Water and shoreline samples are not surveyed water level or bathymetry; default coarse Earth terrain compatibility is not certified.
